effects.prompt: Put an attack reaction card from your graveyard on top of your deck?

_comment:
'When this defends a weapon attack, you may put an attack reaction card from your graveyard on top of your deck. / **Blade Break**' Warrior Equipment - Head (MasteryPackWarrior).

BLADE BREAK NOT AUTHORED: printed keyword (printed_keywords) firing from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it is a defect.

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_DEFEND - the engine dispatches ON_DEFEND per defending card with that card as source (engine.py:1646), so the defending head hears its own trigger; same vehicle as .drafts/flameborn_retribution_red.json, equipment defending. ATTACK_IS_WEAPON reads combat.from_weapon (condition_types.py:198-199) - true exactly when defending a weapon attack, which is release note 1's restriction enforced by the condition rather than extra plumbing.

DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST (it named SEARCH_GRAVEYARD), verified against the handler before deviating: SEARCH_GRAVEYARD (effect_types.py:1835-1892) defaults shuffle=True for every deck destination (:1854-1856) and passes NO position to put_object (:1886-1888), whose zone default appends to the BOTTOM (effect_keywords.py:1658, :1664-1669) - it can neither put the card ON TOP nor skip the shuffle, both of which the text requires. MOVE_MATCHING (effect_types.py:3593-3612) is the established composition for exactly this wording ('put target <card matching X> from <zone> on top of your deck' is its own docstring), used by .drafts/helm_of_hindsight.json (same head-equipment graveyard-to-deck-top clause family) and .drafts/figment_of_rebirth_yellow.json: position 'top' reaches put_object directly (:3609-3611).

YOU MAY: MAY supplies the choice at resolution (release note 1: optional, chosen when the effect resolves); its conditions list gates the OFFER itself - no eligible attack reaction in the graveyard means no prompt at all (the loader pops MAY.conditions into EffectDef.conditions; MAY handler comment effect_types.py:3794-3796). Declining runs nothing in the block.

TYPE FILTER: attack reaction cards store types ['AttackReaction'] in the card DB (verified against affirm_loyalty_red this session); CARD_IS_TYPE reads card_type and folds via _norm, which strips non-alphanumerics, so 'AttackReaction' and 'Attack Reaction' match alike (condition_types.py:1309-1325, :7-15). CARD_IN_ZONE filter_types tests types AND subtypes lowercased (:887-889, :944-948).

Release note 2 (empty deck still allowed): put_object into an empty deck zone works, and position top makes the moved card the top of the deck by construction.
